title: Binance Will List Render (RNDR)
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list  Render (RNDR)  and will open trading for  RNDR/BTC ,  RNDR/BUSD , and  RNDR/USDT  trading pairs at 2021-11-27 10:00 (UTC). Users can now start depositing  RNDR  in preparation for trading Withdrawals for RNDR will open at 2021-11-28 10:00 (UTC) Note: The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status on the withdrawal page What is Render (RNDR)? The Render Network is a provider of decentralized GPU-based rendering solutions for the metaverse. RNDR is its native utility token designed as the payment currency for services offered by Render Network. RNDR Listing Fee: 0 BNB.
